company.name: Longline Labs
company._note: `name` is the brand beside every wordmark; `legalName` is what every site's copyright line says (the shared footer reads it, and no site may override it). `url` is the company site, where the Linked LL in every header leads.
company.familyLine: Six small apps from Longline Labs, built to work alike.

_note: The family, in the order of the six-colour longline. `status` is "live" (the site is up: the switcher and the family section link to it) or "coming-soon" (shown with its mark and accent, labelled Coming soon, not linked). Flip one word to launch. `switcher` says whether the header's switcher lists the app at all. Domains as decided October 30, 2026: ballastbook.com, shipshapefiles.com (the product is ShipShape), aboveboarddocs.com. `appUrl` is the signed-in app (packetskipper.com is both site and app); a person's own apps lead there when the rail knows which apps they use. `buttonAccent`, where set, colours only the filled buttons on that app's own site (reelminders.com takes the family teal, the founder's choice of October 31, 2026); the stripe, the kicker and its card keep `accent`.

apps.name: Coifish
apps.description: Keeps track of vendor insurance. Coifish emails vendors before their coverage ends, collects the new certificate, and holds it for you to approve.

apps.name: ReelMinder
apps.description: Remembers your association deadlines. Insurance renewals, contract renewals, meeting notices: you enter the dates, and ReelMinder emails you what's due every Monday.

apps.name: PacketSkipper
apps.description: Builds the board packet from your agenda, emails it to the board, and drafts the minutes from what you record at the meeting.

apps.name: BallastBook
apps.description: Builds next year's budget for each association. Type the numbers beside last year's, and BallastBook works out what each unit pays and makes the PDF for the board.

apps.name: ShipShape
apps.description: Names your files the way your company names them. Drop in a PDF, answer two or three questions, and download it with the right name.

apps.name: AboveBoard
apps.description: A public page for each association's documents. Upload the bylaws, budgets, and minutes once, and owners, buyers, and lenders find them at one address.
